clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Gryth Thurden is preparing to send a parcel back to Loch Modan. Golnir Bouldertoe has entrusted you with the Honorary Picks for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices, and the city's gryphon roost offers a way across the mountain roads.

After traveling from Loch Modan to the Great Forge, you receive Honorary Picks from Golnir Bouldertoe for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices. Golnir points you toward Ironforge's gryphon network instead of the mountain passes on foot. Carry the bundle across the city to its master handler, who can arrange the flight back.

Gryth Thurden oversees the flight roosts in Ironforge's great mountain hall. The gryphon routes link the city with dwarven settlements across Khaz Modan. After you have scouted the route and spoken with the local handler, Gryth can arrange transport back to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar. The picks are bound for Brock Stoneseeker's apprentices, and the route joins the mountain settlements by air.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!
Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look like you have somewhere to go. Need one of my gryphons?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
